veranderings.rede: 'Kom kyk daarna' is the natural Afrikaans for going to watch a performance; 'kom dit sien' reads stiffly.
'n dans dans' repeats the same word as noun and verb and reads clumsily; 'uitvoer' keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: te praat soos daardie karakter sou
veranderings.na: te praat soos daardie karakter sou doen
veranderings.rede: Ending on a bare 'sou' copies English 'as that character would'; Afrikaans needs a verb after the modal, and 'doen' covers both verbs.
'sy' can be read as 'she' or 'his' and is unclear here; 'n beeld' gives the same image without the unclear pronoun.

vlae.teks: Hulle strek hulle arms, bene en rug na bo.
vlae.rede: 'Strek hulle bene en rug na bo' is an unusual way to put it, and legs are not always stretched upward; a clearer wording would mean guessing what is intended, so this is for the writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Under AWS 2017 a compound built on a hyphenated part is joined with a hyphen ('C-majeur-toonaard'), and the definition itself writes 'majeur-toonaard'; the open spelling in the headword looks inconsistent. This needs a person's decision, because the term is shared with lesson 4.
